title: AI Ad Managers Are Here. But Can They Really Do Your Job? - Sumu Akter

facts.fact: According to the author, Google's AI Max runs ads across Google Search, YouTube, Gmail, Maps, and the Display Network within one campaign.
facts.quote: AI Max runs your ads across Google Search, YouTube, Gmail, Maps, and the Display Network—all in one campaign.

facts.fact: According to the author, Meta's Advantage+ uses the advertiser's pixel data and past conversions to get smarter over time.
facts.quote: It also uses your pixel data and past conversions to get smarter over time.

facts.fact: According to the author, Google's AI Max uses signals from the advertiser's website, CRM, and past user behavior to determine who is most likely to convert.
facts.quote: It also uses signals from your website, CRM, and past user behavior to figure out who’s most likely to convert.
